Usage: spec-driven-steroids validate [options] [command]

Validate Spec-Driven specs for correctness and completeness.

The validate command checks specs in .specs/changes/<slug>/ for:
  • structure   - Required files for brief or full lanes
  • brief       - Compact change brief structure and traceability
  • requirements - EARS patterns, REQ-X numbering, acceptance criteria
  • design      - Mermaid diagrams, DES-X numbering, _Implements tags
  • tasks       - Phase structure, task status, traceability links
  • spec        - Cross-file validation and traceability matrix
  • all         - Aggregate every spec in .specs/changes

All subcommands support --format <text|json> for output control.
Use --help with any subcommand for specific options and examples.

Options:
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  structure [options] <slug>     Validate that a spec directory contains either
                                 brief.md or the full requirements/design/tasks
                                 set
  brief [options] <path>         Validate a brief.md file for structure,
                                 bounded scope, and requirement-to-task
                                 traceability
  requirements [options] <path>  Validate a requirements.md file for EARS
                                 patterns, REQ-X numbering, and acceptance
                                 criteria
  design [options] <path>        Validate a design.md file for Mermaid
                                 diagrams, DES-X numbering, and traceability
                                 links
  tasks [options] <path>         Validate a tasks.md file for phase structure,
                                 task checkboxes, status markers, and
                                 traceability
  spec [options] <slug>          Validate a brief or full spec with cross-file
                                 traceability
  all [options]                  Validate all specs under .specs/changes in one
                                 aggregated result
  help [command]                 display help for command
